brand-pitch-green.$description: Brand Pitch Green. Fills, dark-mode accents, the app icon ground. Never as text on a light ground (2.6:1 on white).

brand-green-dark.$description: Brand Green Dark, kept exact from the brand palette. For icons, focus rings and bold display text 19px+ (3:1 minimum) on surface in the light theme, where it measures 4.07:1. Not a body-text colour, and never drawn on top of another green.

brand-green-light.$description: Brand Green Light. Highlights and the dark-mode focus ring. Ink text on it (10.8:1).

brand-ink.$description: Brand Ink. Dark-mode page ground; text on light grounds and on every green, amber or red fill.

bg.$description: Page ground behind everything (Ink in dark).

surface.$description: Cards, panels, list containers, the sidebar.

surface-raised.$description: Things that sit above a card: menus, popovers, the team-sheet card, inputs in dark. Pair with shadow-2 in light.

surface-overlay.$description: Dialogs and bottom sheets, above scrim.

surface-sunken.$description: Wells: the pitch strip, availability grid ground, input-group tracks, segmented-control tracks.

surface-inverse.$description: Inverse chips and tooltips; text-inverse on it.

surface-hover.$description: Hover wash for rows, ghost buttons and menu items.

surface-pressed.$description: Pressed wash for rows, ghost buttons and menu items.

border-subtle.$description: Decorative dividers and card outlines only — never the only boundary of a control.

border-control.$description: Input, select, toggle-track and secondary-button borders. 3:1+ on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

text-primary.$description: Headings and body on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-overlay, surface-sunken.

text-secondary.$description: Supporting copy, row meta, labels on all surfaces.

text-muted.$description: Placeholders, timestamps, helper text on all surfaces (4.7:1+ dark, 5.2:1+ light).

text-disabled.$description: Disabled control labels only (exempt from contrast, always paired with a disabled cursor/state).

accent-fill.$description: Primary buttons, selected chips, active tab pip, the 'you' marker, team A in the fairness bar. on-accent text on it.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent-fill, highlight and every hover/pressed green (6:1+).

accent-text.$description: Green links, 'View all', active nav labels on bg/surface/surface-raised. Light value deepens Green Dark to pass 4.5:1 at body size.

accent-subtle.$description: Tinted ground for selected rows, 'you' row on leaderboards, available cells.

highlight.$description: Moments of delight: fairness sweet spot, first place, new personal best. Ink text on it.

focus-ring.$description: 2px focus outline, offset 2px. 3:1+ against every surface in its theme.

result-win.$description: Win fill (W chip, ✓). Always with the W letter and ✓ icon; on-result text.

result-loss.$description: Loss fill (L chip, ✗) and destructive fills. Always with the L letter and ✗ icon; on-result text (4.7:1).

result-loss-text.$description: Loss and error text on surfaces.

result-draw.$description: Draw fill (D chip, –). Shared with provisional, so always with a letter or label; on-result text.

on-result.$description: Text on result-win, result-loss, result-draw, provisional and info fills.

result-win-subtle.$description: Win row/tile tint; result-win-text on it.

result-loss-subtle.$description: Loss and error tint; result-loss-text on it.

result-draw-subtle.$description: Draw and provisional tint; result-draw-text on it.

provisional.$description: A score that is not final yet (amber, always with the word "Provisional"), and the legacy "~" rating band until the server sends a number for every player. Not for a settling rating.

provisional-text.$description: Text and outlines for the provisional score state and the legacy "~" rating band.

info.$description: Info fill: tips, 'syncing', notification dots that aren't urgent. on-result text.

info-text.$description: Info text and links inside notices.

info-subtle.$description: Info banner ground; info-text on it.

danger.$description: Destructive buttons, delete confirmations; on-result text.

team-a.$description: Team A side of the fairness meter, scoreboard and team column header. Always labelled with the team name.

team-b.$description: Team B side (a neutral, like a white kit). Always labelled with the team name.

bib.$description: Hi-vis bib orange: the bib flag fill, bib stat tiles. Always with the bib icon and the word BIBS — it sits near loss red and draw amber in hue, so never colour alone. on-bib text on it; 3:1+ as a mark on every ground.

bib-text.$description: Bib orange as text (“in bibs”) on bg, surface, surface-raised.

bib-subtle.$description: Tinted ground for the 'you're in bibs' banner; bib-text on it.

on-bib.$description: Text and stripes on the bib flag.

live.$description: The LIVE dot and running-clock pip (always with the word LIVE).

settling-text.$description: The settling note beside a player whose rating has not settled: the wave mark and the words. Deliberately not a colour of its own, and never applied to the rating number.

pro-fill.$description: The PRO chip. An inverse chip with a star, so it never reads as a result or a state.

on-pro.$description: Text and the star on pro-fill.

locked-border.$description: The dashed outline of a Pro feature the squad does not have. Always with the lock icon.

2.$description: Menus, popovers, the notifications panel, dragged player chips.

glow.$description: The fairness meter in its sweet spot (48–52%), the Lock teams button when ready, the watch goal ring.
